origin.description: Check a figure handle, or open an Agg figure, and return what R returns.
origin.details: figure() returns None. Handles 0 and 1 raise the R errors.
origin.value: Check a figure handle, or open an Agg figure, and return what R returns.
origin.example: { old <- getwd(); setwd(tempdir()); figure(); while (dev.cur() > 1) dev.off(); setwd(old); NULL }
